purpose: Isolate whether an Ollama OpenAI chat request changing its tool catalog invalidates prompt-cache reuse.

method.messages: Identical synthetic system and user messages for every call; content not retained.
method.tool_schemas: Five representative workspace schemas; schema text not retained.
method.cache_reset: Model unloaded and identically rewarmed before each sequence.

finding: For this request shape, repeating the same tool catalog reused 570 of 574 prompt tokens. Changing from five tool schemas to zero reused no prompt tokens.
limitations: The five schemas were representative synthetic workspace schemas, not captured Hermes schemas.
This isolates Ollama cache behavior and does not measure the complete HADES review path or establish how much of the end-to-end delay it explains.
